releaseNotes: v1.3.2 -- Fixed a false negative in PTZ Calibration detection: switched the primary signal from supportPtzCalibration to supportPtzCheck, which matched real calibration availability on every camera tested (supportPtzCalibration is now just a secondary safety-net check). Also includes v1.3.1 (fixed doorbell driver missing the push() command; fixed supportedFeatures under-reporting doorbell lighting; confirmed supportAiPackage as the real package-detection field).
author: jdthomas24
